title: Chocolate Brown Fall Home Decor
headline: Chocolate Brown Fall Home Decor: 8 Amazon Finds for a Warm, Expensive-Looking Living Room
seo_title: Chocolate Brown Fall Home Decor: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Chocolate brown fall home decor from Amazon: a chunky knit throw, velvet and boucle pillow covers, a faux fur rug, a cordless lamp and more. Eight best-reviewed picks.
intro: Chocolate brown is the color of the season, darling. It's warmer than black, richer than beige, and it makes even a budget room look like a boutique hotel.

I went through Amazon and built a chocolate brown fall home edit: textiles, lighting and a few pieces that hold the whole look together. Every pick is rated 4.4 stars or higher with real review counts, and I checked that a chocolate or dark brown color option exists on each listing.
On every product page, choose the Chocolate Brown (or listed brown) color option before you buy, since many of these come in several colors.
I haven't tested these. I'm telling you what's well reviewed and very giftable for your own couch. Let's make it cozy.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: Bigacogo Chunky Knit Throw Blanket
products.best_for: The couch layer that does half the decorating
copy: A chunky knit throw in a deep chocolate shade. Drape it over a sofa arm and the room looks styled.
It has a 4.5-star rating from more than 3,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the cozy centerpiece. Pick the chocolate option.

products.name: Velvet Throw Pillow Covers, 18x18, Chocolate Brown (2-pack)
products.best_for: Instant richness for a sofa or bed
copy: Soft velvet covers in a true chocolate brown. They're covers only, so you add your own inserts.
They rate 4.6 stars from nearly 35,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the easiest swap for a new look.

products.name: MIULEE Boucle Pillow Covers, 20x20
copy: Boucle adds the nubby, textured look that's everywhere right now. Choose a brown shade on the page.
They have a 4.4-star rating from more than 1,300 reviewers.
Verdict: mix with velvet for depth.

products.name: Ashler Faux Fur Rug, Shaggy, Dark Coffee
products.best_for: The soft landing under a coffee table
copy: A fluffy faux fur rug in a dark coffee tone. Check the size options on the page.
It rates 4.5 stars from nearly 51,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the cozy floor.

products.name: Kakanuo Brown Cordless Table Lamp, Rechargeable
copy: A rechargeable cordless lamp in brown that works on a shelf, a dinner table or a nightstand.
It has a 4.4-star rating from more than 2,200 reviewers.
Verdict: warm glow, zero outlet drama.

products.name: Woven Storage Baskets, Brown, 6-Pack
products.best_for: Hide the clutter, keep the cozy
copy: A set of woven baskets in brown for blankets, toys and remotes.
They rate 4.8 stars from more than 8,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the practical pick that looks styled.

products.name: Solid Wood Candle Holders, Set of 3, Burnt Rustic
products.best_for: A mantel moment in dark wood
copy: Three wooden holders in different heights with a dark, burnt finish.
They have a 4.6-star rating from nearly 1,000 reviewers.
Verdict: grouped in threes, they look designed.

products.name: MIULEE Faux Fur Sherpa Pillow Covers, Chocolate
products.best_for: Winter texture for a fall couch
copy: A soft sherpa cover in chocolate. It adds a fluffy contrast to velvet.
They rate 4.4 stars from nearly 1,000 reviewers.
Verdict: finishes the pillow stack.

interludes.3: Rule one of the chocolate room: layer three textures, one color.
interludes.6: Rule two: add one warm light. Everything looks expensive by lamplight.

outro: And that's the edit: eight Amazon finds for a chocolate brown fall home.
If you take one thing from this guide, let it be this. Start with the throw and the velvet pillows, and the room changes overnight.
